message.Title: Retirement: Migration of Azure Batch Low-Priority VMs to Spot VMs in early March

Body.Content:
Azure Batch had retired Low-Priority VMs on September 30, 2025 and will begin a system-initiated migration to Spot VMs beginning March 1, 2026. This change aligns Batch with the broader Azure Spot infrastructure and simplifies the platform’s VM offering. 

Impact: 

  • The migration will occur automatically and be completed within several days. 
  • No interruption to existing workloads is expected. 
  • Customers will see Spot-based billing beginning with the March invoice.  

Action required: 

  • No action is required if you choose to continue using Spot VMs after the migration. 
  • If you prefer not to transition, you may migrate your Batch workloads to dedicated (on-demand) compute nodes before end of February. After this deadline: 
    • Low-priority VMs can no longer be created. 
    • Existing Low-priority VMs will be billed at Spot pricing.  

Details: 

  • All current Low-Priority VMs will automatically run as Spot VMs after migration. 
  • Batch-managed pool allocation will handle the transition seamlessly. 
  • Existing API/SDK references to Low-Priority VM properties will automatically allocate Spot capacity without changes to customer code or configuration.  

Learn more.
